rule: These requests deduplicate Wave 1 proposals. They authorize no production change and no final assembly.

requests.title: Shared identifier, time, version, validation, and schema governance
requests.decision: Adopt Session 1 schemaVersion=1, ValidationResult, registry, byte-preserving ID boundary, and unsupported-version quarantine. Add one authorized household IANA time-zone source and audience/data-class metadata for registry entries.
acceptanceCriteria: All boundary inputs are unknown until migrated and validated.
Canonical IDs are preserved byte-for-byte.
Learner-local dates are derived with the snapshotted authorized IANA zone.
Adult-private schemas require an explicit capability.
Unsupported versions are preserved unchanged in quarantine.

requests.title: Versioned sidecar persistence, CAS, append-only ledgers, and outbox
requests.decision: Provide a host-owned sidecar keyed by stable identifiers, optimistic aggregate revision, append-only APIs, functional/CAS updates, and an outbox for cross-projection effects. Calendar writes remain separately authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: Same command replay is a no-op.
Same idempotency key with different payload is quarantined.
Concurrent stale revision writes fail without partial projection.
Session event prefixes cannot be rewritten.
Review-result saga can resume without duplicates.

requests.title: Adult-private repository, audience scope, and safe projections
requests.decision: Store private note bodies only in the adult-private repository with explicit audience scope. Ordinary controls, action logs, dashboards, diagnostics, and analytics carry only references, categories, counts, and timestamps.
acceptanceCriteria: No note body occurs in ParentControlState or actionLog.
Parent-only visibility is never widened to authorized-adults-only.
Private repository authorization is distinct from the student-safe registry.
Deletion and retention can operate without rewriting public ledgers.

requests.title: Verified Tutor Core directive, evidence, safety, media, and review bridge
requests.decision: Bind only to symbols inspected in the actual Tutor Core v0.2 package. The bridge must cover mastery, misconception, prerequisite, uncertainty, reteaching, safety, visual-board commands, spoken turns, captions, transcripts, adult-review evidence, review priority, and review-result return.
acceptanceCriteria: Actual Tutor Core archive/package hash and manifest are recorded.
Every mapped enum value is exhaustive and loss-aware.
Unknown Tutor Core versions and enum values quarantine.
Tutor Core learner-facing rendering replaces Session 2 free-text coach rendering.
Study Engine receives references/structured outcomes, not raw transcripts or answers.

requests.title: Typed accommodation and precedence policy
deduplicates: Session-2 focus and break policy gaps
requests.decision: Make controls the authorization source and focus profile the read-only applied projection. Represent requiredness and operational effects as catalog-backed typed constraints. Resolve policy by constraint intersection and clamp before manual/engine/default candidates.
acceptanceCriteria: Safety constraints cannot be overridden.
Required accommodations compose across dimensions.
Hard maximum is applied before hold/manual target.
Infeasible intersections produce manual-review and no automatic target.
Learner-facing accommodation text comes from an approved Tutor Core/UX catalog.

requests.title: Exact-resume checkpoint and event replay contract
requests.decision: Keep one canonical ResumePoint and add a versioned, device/runtime UX checkpoint behind opaque references. Tutor Core item/substep symbols remain gated by the actual v0.2 package.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkpoint validates plan, session, segment, aggregate revision, token, and version.
Raw drafts remain in a device-local vault referenced by responseDraftRef.
Refresh restores exact UI/runtime cursor without replaying completion events.
Unsupported/corrupt checkpoints quarantine with an adult-safe recovery/export path.

requests.title: Review occurrence, retry-not-before, and result-return seam
requests.decision: Keep StudentSkillReview canonical and treat queue/calendar rows as idempotent occurrences. Add a versioned completion/result command and outbox flow. Same-day failure requires support plus a boundary and an authorized retryNotBefore policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Review occurrence has stable ID and canonical ReviewId.
Priority/kind come from Tutor Core or a verified catalog.
Queue completion follows evidence/result append.
Same-day never means immediate and no clock time is invented.
Result replay never duplicates RetrievalAttempt or next-review revision.

requests.title: Credential-free Romeo metadata intake
requests.decision: Accept only versioned, credential-free assignment metadata. Replace arbitrary URLs with an opaque host-resolved launchRef; remove resumeNote from the shared payload. Type tutoring support as StudyPlanId and keep dueDate as a date.
acceptanceCriteria: No token, cookie, userinfo, arbitrary URI, secret-bearing query/path/fragment, or free-form resume note crosses.
Unknown versions quarantine.
A due date is never converted to midnight.
Romeo progress and Manuel tutoring progress remain separate.

requests.title: Minimized integration telemetry and learner-safe catalog text
requests.decision: Telemetry uses identifiers, bounded codes, counts, timestamps, versions, and dispositions only. Learner/parent-facing text is generated from verified Tutor Core or approved catalog content.
acceptanceCriteria: No raw payload, answer, transcript, note body, credential, or unrestricted string is logged.
Review titles and parent evidence descriptions are catalog-derived.
Diagnostics use fixed reason codes and opaque quarantine references.
No hidden behavior score is created.
